name: kondi-instagram-mcp
description: MCP server providing Instagram Business Graph API tools

tools.name: ig_publish_photo
tools.description: Publish a photo to Instagram Business account. Two-step process: creates a media container then publishes it.

tools.name: ig_get_media
tools.description: Get recent media posts from an Instagram Business account with captions, types, URLs, and timestamps.

tools.name: ig_get_post_insights
tools.description: Get insights (impressions, reach, engagement) for a specific Instagram media post.
